task_items: deployment_report.txt, text file, /home/user/deployments, opened with any text editor, contains detailed deployment process information
deployment_status.json, JSON file, /var/logs, opened with any text editor, tracks deployment success or failure
deployment_notifications.sh, shell script, /home/user/scripts, executed in terminal, sends notifications about deployment status
Slack, messaging application, used to send deployment updates to a designated channel
PagerDuty, application, triggers alerts for deployment failures
curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"status": "success"}' <Webhook_URL>, command, executed in terminal, sends deployment success notifications to a webhook
global_task_intention: Manage and automate deployment notifications and reporting
